snippet.title: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover – The Story Begins
snippet.description:
Thanks @ScumHouseStudio and @brockbaker for making my dream come to live!

Wishlist Olaf and the Crowning Hangover on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3001110/Olaf_and_the_Crowning_Hangover/

It is a first cutscene for my coming game Olaf and the Crowning Hangover. Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.
